about: FP-295 B45 Stage 5: explanation questions from the coverage audit (2026-10-22-fp295-analytics-chat-coverage-audit.md §6). Each must be explained from the page guide (`explain`), with no period question. must_mention lists facts the guide holds; any one spelling in a list will do.

questions.question: How do we come up with operating cost?
questions.page_shows: Road distance × (fuel + other running per km) + driving hours × driver rate + fixed; today's rates (fuel R 17.64/km).

questions.question: What do the "Cost at a glance" figures tell us?
questions.page_shows: Operating cost (estimate), delay cost on problem trips (estimate, beside, never added), cargo value exposed (from waybills).

questions.question: Where does the cargo value exposed come from?
questions.page_shows: Declared value on Parcel Perfect waybills, every consignment on closed trips with a theft sign; the whole load counts.

questions.question: Why isn't delay cost added to operating cost?
questions.page: Cost → Cost at a glance note
questions.page_shows: The driver's late hours are already inside operating cost; adding would count them twice.

questions.question: Where did the diesel price come from?
questions.page_shows: DMPR inland 50ppm, 7 Oct 2026: R 33.29 per litre (starting rate, unless an admin changed it).

questions.question: What does the Live trips tile count?
questions.page_shows: Trips created, underway or on hold: includes planned trips not yet departed.

questions.question: Why are planned trips included in Live trips?
questions.page_shows: The tile counts status created (planned, not yet departed) as well as active and on hold.

questions.question: What counts as an unused vehicle?
questions.page_shows: Active truck or trailer with no departure in the last 30 SAST days and not on a live trip.

questions.question: What's the purpose of the Trips over time chart?
questions.page_shows: Answers 'Are we getting busier?'; closed trips by first departure, loaded and empty.

questions.question: Why are trips grouped by the day they departed and not by when they finished?
questions.page_shows: So every figure agrees with the driver, vehicle and site detail pages (page spec D8).

questions.question: How are cancellations counted?
questions.page_shows: By the day cancelled, against every trip that ended (cancelled + closed) in the bucket.

questions.question: How is the busy patterns average worked out?
questions.page_shows: Events ÷ number of such days in the period; the 31st only divided by months that have one.

questions.question: What counts as on time?
questions.page: On time → On-time departures and arrivals
questions.page_shows: On or before the planned time, no grace minutes; only trips with planned times.

questions.question: What does "early" mean in How late is late?
questions.page: On time → How late is late
questions.page_shows: More than 15 minutes ahead of plan.

questions.question: What does Plans vs reality show, and why was it made?
questions.page_shows: Actual trip time vs planned, early on the left, over on the right; answers 'Are our planned times realistic?'.

questions.question: Why aren't dispatcher notes counted as problems?
questions.page_shows: One is recorded automatically for every cancellation and override; counting them would inflate problems.

questions.question: Which problem types count as theft signs, and why isn't "seal unverified" one?
questions.page_shows: 8 types from THEFT_SIGNAL_TYPES; seal unverified is a paperwork gap, not tampering.

questions.question: Why does Problems over time show counts and not a rate per 100 trips?
questions.page_shows: '400 per 100' on two trips misled (page spec D25); the rate per trip is in the tooltip and table.

questions.question: How does Risky times of day decide a time of day is risky?
questions.page_shows: Share of problems while driving vs share of driving time per SAST quarter-day.

questions.question: What does "Not linked to a step" mean in Where in the trip?
questions.page_shows: A report raised outside any trip step.

questions.question: What goes into the review queue?
questions.page_shows: Every exception starts as needs review (since 29 Sep 2026); the queue charts follow the critical ones.

questions.question: Why is review speed shown as a median?
questions.page: Review desk → How fast critical problems get reviewed
questions.page_shows: One problem left for a week would drag an average far from the usual wait.

questions.question: What does a big "data discrepancy" share mean?
questions.page_shows: Automatic checks are raising false alarms.

questions.question: How is tracker agreement worked out, and is the tracker real?
questions.page_shows: Confirmed ÷ (confirmed + mismatch); simulated Pulsit feed.

questions.question: What's an override and why does it matter?
questions.page_shows: A dispatcher completing a step for the driver; it skips photos, seal and tracker check.

questions.question: Why does receiver sign-off look low before mid-September?
questions.page_shows: Receiver QR sign-off went live on 13 Sep 2026.

questions.question: What does the Lane risk chart show, and what do the faint lines mean?
questions.page_shows: Trips across, problems per trip up; faint lines = the average lane; top-right busy and risky.

questions.question: Why are some lanes faded in Driving time per lane?
questions.page: Routes & sites → Driving time per lane
questions.page_shows: Fewer than 5 trips: too few to compare fairly.

questions.question: Why is the last bar faded?
questions.page_shows: A part week/month/year, or one still running.

questions.question: What does View by change, and why can't I pick Week for all time?
questions.page_shows: Groups the bars; at most 53 bars, so a long period needs Month or Year.

questions.question: How did we get to the operating cost for the last 12 weeks?
questions.page: Cost → Cost at a glance + rates
questions.page_shows: The figure for the last 12 weeks and how it is built from distance, hours and today's rates.

questions.question: Which driver causes the most problems?
questions.page_shows: No driver ranking on the page by design (page spec D13); per-driver figures are on each driver's page.
